title: Satin Chrome Toilet Paper Holder With Glass Shelf, 8.75-Inch Wall Mount, Covered Two-Post Solid Brass, Allied Brass
description:
Keep toilet tissue within reach while adding a dry, convenient spot for small essentials above the roll in Satin Chrome, which provides a brushed, matte-like surface that resists fingerprints while maintaining a modern, understated elegance. This wall-mounted toilet paper holder pairs a covered, two-post design with an integrated glass shelf for organized, space-smart bathroom storage.

- Protects tissue from moisture and dust with a covered design
- Adds a glass shelf to keep items up and dry
- Creates a clean look with concealed screw mounting
- Built from solid brass for enduring everyday use
- Coordinates with transitional bath accessories in the Waverly Place collection

Specs: Overall size 8.75 in L x 4.6 in H x 6 in W; projection 6 in. Material: brass. Mounting: wall mount with concealed screws (#8 x 1 1/4"). Weight capacity: 250 lb. Includes toilet paper holder and all installation hardware. Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty.
